gh_app.title: GHProgrammingApp
features: Application for learning programming, starting with theory.
Quiz with questions based on the theory of each level.
Tutorial to identify the person's appropriate level.
It currently includes levels 1 and 2 to get started.

inventory_app.title: GH Inventory Control System
inventory_app.summary: Desktop system for a neighborhood distributor: manages stock, purchases and sales with three user roles.
inventory_app.problem: The distributor had no reliable way to track its stock and sales.
roles: Administrator: registers managers and employees, views deactivated users and reactivates them.
Manager: creates, updates and deletes products and customers, handles stock purchases and sales.
Employee: makes in-store sales or sales to a specific customer.
highlights: University final project in C# with Windows Forms and MySQL.

experience.title: Professional Experience
description: I worked as a developer on various tasks, such as creating a refund page that allowed users to request a refund or cancel a completed transaction.

I also worked on the request editing feature, where users could search for a transaction number and verify the submitted information. If there was incorrect data or a wrong receipt, they could report the issue and upload the correct file.
